content.text:
Report written to `/app/report.json`. Summary of what I found (14 of 20 re-runs used):

**Why offline missed it:** the release eval slice has `leak = 0.54` (measured by the lab, not the assumed 0.0). Decontaminating the release config drops offline slice from 0.900 → 0.793, matching the online 0.799. So I used `decontaminate` as a cheap proxy for online throughout.

**Cause: `lr_scale`.** The recipe learning rate (1.0) is wrong for the smaller student — the optimum shifted upward when `capacity` was cut (exactly the "never re-tuned lr after changing model size" gap):

| config (decontaminated ≈ online) | slice |
|---|---|
| release (cap 0.676, lr 1.0) | 0.793 |
| cap 0.676, lr 1.25 (re-tune lr only) | 0.871 |
| cap 0.773, lr 1.0 (reset capacity only) | 0.858 |
| cap 0.773, lr 1.15 / 1.20 / 1.25 | 0.894 / 0.892 / 0.891 |
| cap 0.773, lr 0.8 / 1.33 / 1.5 | 0.738 / 0.870 / 0.787 |

Re-tuning lr alone at release capacity recovers more of the regression than the maximum allowed capacity revert does, and holding lr at 1.0 still reproduces most of the loss even after capacity is moved back to the cap. `mixture` was ruled out: it is already at its recipe value (1.0) and cannot go higher.

**Fix:** `{"lr_scale": 1.2, "capacity": 0.773}` — lr at the center of the 1.15–1.25 plateau, plus capacity moved back as far as the release note permits. Expected online ≈ 0.89 vs the ~0.90 ceiling reachable under the constraint.
